scope: Research inventory only; no physics-model inputs or claims of simulator calibration.

provenance_codes.scan: Direct PDF of a period report located; a link is not proof every page or figure was checked.
provenance_codes.transcription: Period report reproduced as searchable HTML by WWII Aircraft Performance; figures must be checked against original scans before high-confidence calibration.
provenance_codes.graph: Photographic reproduction of original figure or sheet; numeric summary may be rounded.
provenance_codes.catalog: Original institutional catalogue entry; numerical observations not independently read.
provenance_codes.specification: Contemporary manufacturer specification or estimated/design performance, not a flight measurement.
